title: Dorman 96024 2in x 18in Aluminum HVAC Control Duct Hose NOS
description_markdown:
Dorman 96024 NOS HVAC Control Duct Hose - Aluminum 2" x 18"

Discover this New Old Stock (NOS) Dorman 96024 HVAC Control Duct Hose, ensuring original quality and performance for your vehicle's heating and cooling system. Crafted from durable aluminum, this 18-inch hose provides reliable airflow management and consistent temperature control for a wide range of compatible Buick, Cadillac, Chevrolet, Dodge, Ford, Jeep, Lincoln, Mercury, Oldsmobile, and Pontiac models.

Key Features & Benefits:

  • NOS Quality: Genuine New Old Stock part ensures original manufacturer specifications and performance.
  • Durable Construction: Made from high-quality aluminum for enhanced resistance to heat, corrosion, and longevity.
  • Optimal Airflow: 2-inch diameter engineered for efficient and consistent air distribution within your HVAC system.
  • Secure Installation: Features a clamp attachment method for a tight and straightforward setup.
  • Complete Package: Includes one (1) HVAC control duct hose, typically in its original manufacturer's box.
